scripts.dev: npm run build -w @student-task-manager/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @student-task-manager/api" "npm run dev -w @student-task-manager/web"
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build -w @student-task-manager/shared && npm run dev -w @student-task-manager/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @student-task-manager/shared && npm run build -w @student-task-manager/api && npm run build -w @student-task-manager/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @student-task-manager/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @student-task-manager/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
